en.name: ilyautov/moysklad-mcp-ru

API amounts are in kopecks and read tools convert to rubles. Auto-pagination, multiple cabinets, Russian-language catalog search. Install: `uvx moysklad-mcp-ru`; stdio; token from MoySklad Settings -> Users -> Access tokens, stored locally at `~/.moysklad-mcp/cabinets.json` (chmod 600). Clients: Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode. Method map and setup: https://moysklad-mcp-ru.aifrontier.tech/ . Official MCP Registry id `io.github.ilyautov/moysklad-mcp-ru`.
